title: Mixed crafts result
description: With this data pack, all your crafting results will be mixed up.
body: With this data pack, all your crafting results will be mixed up. Instead of an iron pickaxe, you'll get something else, and if you want to make planks from a log, you won't be able to! This data pack may make the game more challenging. Each data pack version also has its own variety, so if you want to experience more randomness, just download a different version!
